name: tree-host
description: Tree Host: Minecraft server hosting platform (website, billing, dashboard, Docker-isolated servers)

scripts.check: node -e "for (const d of ['src','public']) for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync(d)) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', d + '/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
